title: Steel Refinery

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Turns raw ores into refined ores

body:
"An improved version of the rusty refinery, providing the same usage!"

Description

The Steel Refinery is the second obtainable tier of refineries. It can be found and purchased at The Oak Depot. It is used to smelt raw ores/rocks into refined ores/rocks by putting them through its conveyor. Some ores/rocks may not fit through, so a Steel, or Refined Chisel may be needed.

The description says: An improved version of the rusty refinery, providing the same usage!

Appearance

A vastly improved refinery compared to the rusty refinery, it is a metal refinery with a larger space for ores/rocks.

Trivia

  • If an object blocking the output, it will not produce (same with forgers and plankers).
    • During blockage it will save entered materials (the amount of them is shown in stat info menu), after removing blockage it will produce all queued materials from first entered to last entered.
